text: Earth and everyone in it, sing!
Shout the news of his victory from sea to sea,
News of his wonders to one and all!
His terrible beauty makes the gods look cheap;
A powerful beauty sets him apart.
Everyone join in the great shout: Encore! In awe before the beauty, in awe before the might.
He put the world on a firm foundation; He treats everyone fair and square.
With Earth joining in, And a huge round of applause from Sea.
Animals, come dance, Put every tree of the forest in the choir—
As he comes to set everything right on earth, Set everything right, treat everyone fair.
